input.summary:
P1 upper hall (parts/room-13.mjs) now writes nothing, so make.sh shows no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for it; build.nbt is produced (5948 cells).
The dresser, rug, reading-corner set and lanterns are NOT placed: all 13 writes landed on air that shell-west carves and runParts locks.
Layout arrays are kept in the file; the layers() call is commented out with the reason.

waste.what: Finding why the 13 writes were refused: I read shell-west.mjs house(), the runParts lock rules and the room's cells by hand to learn that the shell's interior air fill is what locks them.
waste.cost: about 6 tool calls and several file reads; no blocks were placed by hand
waste.tool: mcd plan should mark cells that an earlier part carved to air as locked (e.g. 'L', not '.' free floor), and runParts could report, per part, which target cells are locked before the build runs.

waste.what: Checking whether a room's furniture fits: mcd plan printed P1 upper hall as '.' free floor, which is wrong for a cell the shell has locked as air.
waste.cost: one misleading plan read and one make.sh run to find the 13 refusals
waste.tool: A pre-flight check (runParts --dry-run or mcd plan --locks) that lists each room's target cells against the locked set, so the shell/room conflict shows before the build.

companions.task: Change the interior air fill in shell-west.mjs house() so that each P1 upper-hall furniture cell (x22..25, y6..8, z14..20) is left unbuilt, or agree a rule that room parts may own their interior air; then the room part can be re-enabled.
Re-check the P1 upper hall layout (dresser, rug, reading corner, lanterns) with mcd room for walkability and light once the cells are writable, since the layout has not been tested in place.

left: P1 upper hall furniture is not placed: the dresser (barrels, potted poppy, lantern), red rug, reading corner (fence table, two stair chairs, lantern) are all absent. Their cells are interior air the shell carves at y2..top (shell-west.mjs house(), line 16), and runParts locks them.

Fix belongs outside this file: shell-west.mjs must leave these cells unbuilt, or the lock must allow room parts to write their own air. The layout is kept in room-13.mjs (LEGEND/FLOOR/SHELF/LAMP) and the layers() call is commented out, ready to restore.
Not verified in place: mcd room / mcd light / mcd walk on this room, since nothing is placed.
Other room parts (rooms 1-12 and 14-55 in parts/) contain no layers() calls and place nothing, so they will hit the same lock once they write; the same shell fix applies to every room.
